I've read what I need, so here's the answer.

## Where it's opened
- `GameConsoleComponent.openInventory()` at `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts:237`.
- The Inventory button in `game-console.component.html:9` triggers it with `(click)="openInventory()"`.
- It calls `MatDialog.open(InventoryComponent, { data, panelClass: 'inv-dialog-panel', maxHeight: '90vh' })`.
- The `afterClosed()` subscriber is an empty stub, because the dialog has already updated the state service.

## Data passed
`InventoryDialogData`, delivered to the dialog as `MAT_DIALOG_DATA`:
```ts
{ characterId: this.characterId, sessionId: this.sessionId }
```
The dialog only uses `characterId`. `sessionId` is passed but not used in any API call.

## API calls
All go through `GameApiService` (`services/game-api.service.ts`):

| Method | HTTP | Triggered by |
|---|---|---|
| `getInventory(characterId)` | `GET /api/character/:id`, which returns only `inventory` | Dialog init (`inventory.component.ts:59`) |
| `equipItem(characterId, itemId, equipped)` | `PATCH /api/character/:id/equip` with body `{ itemId, equipped }` | Equip or unequip a weapon or armor (line 77) |
| `dropItem(characterId, itemId)` | `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` | Drop, after `confirm()` (line 150), and also Use Potion (line 123) |

Each successful response replaces the local `inventory` signal and calls `CharacterStateService.setInventory`.

## Gotchas (from `inventory.component.md`)
- Use Potion has no endpoint of its own. It rolls the `heal` dice in the browser, calls `dropItem` to consume one, and sets HP locally with `setCharacter`. The HP is never saved to the server (bugs.md B-05).
- The dialog opens at the bottom of the page instead of centered (B-14).
